$comment: How far a full battery takes each app's scooters, pessimistically, in metres: the range filter judges a scooter that reports a battery and no range by its battery times its app's figure here (issue #12).

Each is the lowest full battery measured in any one feed of 50 scooters or more on the cache's snapshot of 9 November 2026: the median of range over battery where a feed gives both, or the 99th percentile of the ranges where it gives only ranges (Lime in Baden-Württemberg, 11.5 km, where its other feeds read about 40 km).
An app missing here, as those that report a battery and never a range (Jet, Beam, Xingxing, Binbin, Kickgoing, Qick, Alpaca), takes defaultMeters: 3 km needs 30%.
Better figures, for each city, can replace these later: the cache sends the ones it uses with each answer (batteryRanges).
